method: Index each of six faces separately, including repeated labels; enumerate all 36 independent face pairs for each of twelve ordered comparisons. All six unordered pairs covered; reverse directions retained.
observations: Each of the four favored cycle edges has 24 wins/36 outcomes = 2/3.
Orange against blue has 20 wins/36 outcomes = 5/9; yellow against green has 18/36 = 1/2.
No distinct-die pairing has ties. Opposite pairings do not inherit the cycle’s 2/3 probability.
Individual realized numbers remain ordered normally. Nontransitivity concerns pairwise win probabilities, not greater-than on actual numbers.
Every favorable edge still has 12 losing face pairs. No finite winning sequence or physical fairness experiment inferred.
